messages:
Sana (Sales): Heads-up — EdgeGuard POC perf run tonight 10pm PT. Need final runbook, KMS overhead numbers for security team, and an updated pricing delta for Dedicated vs Hosted so I can answer procurement.

Marco (Solutions Eng): OK. Target throughput? payload size? model? qps shape?

Sana (Sales): Customer will simulate 500–1000 qps production peak, esp. 15s microbursts at 5x. Using dispatch -> text-generation (gpt-like). avg prompt 350 tokens, completion 150 tokens.

Priya (SRE): For KMS: are they using customer-managed KMS via Redwood Private? If yes, expect ~5–12ms added per request for HSM roundtrip depending on config. If it's in-cloud KMS (kms.googleapis.com / aws-kms) + regional, ~10–50ms tail. Need test harness to pin it.

Raj (Bench Eng): I'll run 3-phase: 10m ramp, 30m steady @500 qps, then microburst 3x @2500 qps for 2m, back to steady. Will collect p50/p95/p99, cpu/gpu util, queue depth. Using loadgen: 
```
loadgen --target 500 --burst 2500 --model redwood/gpt-3e --prompt-size 350 --completion 150 --kms-mode remote
```

Marco (Solutions Eng): Also add two routing configs: Hosted (multi-tenant) vs Dedicated pool with 100% reserved. That will let us show delta in p99 and cost per 1M tokens.

perf-bot: perf-job 1767774444-edgeguard-run completed. metrics: avg latency 210ms, p95 380ms, p99 610ms, peak throughput 2.4k qps sustained 90s. KMS-overhead-tagged: avg +22ms, p99 +86ms. GPU util: 73% steady, queue spikes during microburst -> 400ms extra queuing.

Sana (Sales): Nice. Marco, can you translate those into pricing delta for their procurement sheet? They asked committed vs on-demand costs + burst SLA.

Marco (Solutions Eng): Rough numbers: Hosted on-demand: $0.018 / 1k tokens (gen + prompts) ; Dedicated reserved baseline: $0.012 / 1k tokens + $X/month for reserved pool (depends on GPU type). With KMS remote overhead, effective cost increases ~3-4% due to longer runtime. For burst SLA add-on estimate +20% uplift or a small burst-capacity buffer.

Priya (SRE): Blocker: security team flagged requirement for attestable HSM logs + long-retention audit. Private deploy + HSM in-customer-vpc only path — need Sales + Legal to sign standard addendum. This will delay private option by ~2 weeks.

Sana (Sales): Ok I'll flag that to the customer. For now send them the perf-job summary and the run artifacts link: https://artifacts.redwood/prof/1767774444

Raj (Bench Eng): I'll upload raw traces and flamegraphs. Quick note — if we toggle prefix caching + KV cache warm, p99 drops to ~420ms. Should we show warm-cache numbers too?

Marco (Solutions Eng): Yes, show both cold and warm cache runs. Also include the inference config we used: batching=auto, max_batch_tokens=4096, quant=fp16.

Sana (Sales): Perfect — thanks team. I'll send results and set call with procurement on Thurs. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: created run artifacts at https://artifacts.redwood/prof/1767774444/logs.zip
